name: António José da Silva
contribution: A Brazilian-Portuguese dramatist born in colonial Brazil, known as "the Jew".

checks.lead: António José da Silva Coutinho (8 May 1705 – 18 October 1739) was a Brazilian-Portuguese dramatist born in colonial Brazil, known as "the Jew" (O Judeu). The Brazilian spelling of his first name is Antônio; António José da Silva Coutinho in Hebrew is אנטוניו ז'וזה דה סילווה.
